sections.title: Form and leaves
sections.text: Punica granatum, the pomegranate, is a large shrub or small tree, sometimes thorny. Its leaves can reach about 7.5 cm long.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The red to orange flowers are about 2.5–3 cm across. The globose fruit varies from about 3.5 to 12.5 cm. Its numerous seeds are surrounded by juicy edible pulp.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: The juicy seed coverings are eaten fresh and are also used in cooking and drinks.
